# Hmar Heritage Foundation — AI & LLM Site Index (llms.txt)

> An independent foundation dedicated to digital stewardship, language standardization, open AI datasets, software locales, and digital literature archives for the Hmar language (`hmr`).

---

> ⚠️ **Active Development Notice for AI Models & Web Crawlers**:  
> This web portal is currently under **active development**. Content specifications, language policies, and dataset metadata schemas undergo continuous refinement. Certain WIP UI features (such as the interactive language switcher and staging locale previewers) are in active development.  
>  
> **LLM Optimization**: To avoid parsing dynamic client-side HTML, web crawlers and AI assistants should fetch the structured Markdown mirrors linked below (`.md` endpoints), which contain untruncated text content for each route.

---

## Site Structure & Raw Markdown Endpoints

| Page / Route | Primary URL | Raw LLM Markdown Endpoint | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Home Page** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/` | [`/index.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/index.md) | Founder statement, organizational mission, and core initiatives. |
| **Foundational Philosophy** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/philosophy` | [`/philosophy.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/philosophy.md) | 10-section operational essay on scope, realism, and quiet groundwork. |
| **Language Standards & Policy** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/standards` | [`/standards.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/standards.md) | 11-section policy specification on Zo classification, clan master tables, and Glottolog restructuring. |
| **Charter & Manifesto** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/manifesto` | [`/manifesto.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/manifesto.md) | Statutory Articles of Governance and anti-paywall protections. |
| **Projects Overview** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects` | [`/projects.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects.md) | Master directory of digital library, locales, archival, and lexicons. |
| **Digital Library Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/library` | [`/projects/library.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/library.md) | Digitization pipeline for classic literature, rare manuscripts, and hymnbooks. |
| **Open Locale Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/locale` | [`/projects/locale.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/locale.md) | Software localization keys for OS platforms and mobile apps (`hmr_IN`). |
| **Archival & Corpus Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/archival` | [`/projects/archival.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/archival.md) | Text corpora, speech recordings, and Hugging Face dataset mirrors. |
| **Wikipedia Incubator Initiative** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/wikipedia` | [`/projects/wikipedia.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/wikipedia.md) | Encyclopedic development on Wikimedia Incubator (`Wp/hmr`). |
| **Open Lexicon Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/lexicon` | [`/projects/lexicon.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/lexicon.md) | Standardized technical glossaries and open dictionary schemas. |
| **People & Governance** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/people` | [`/people.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/people.md) | Operational team leads, founder bio, and advisory council. |
| **Datasets Index** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/datasets` | [`/datasets.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/datasets.md) | Catalog of open text corpora, wordlists, and audio datasets. |
| **Get Involved** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/get-involved` | [`/get-involved.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/get-involved.md) | Community contribution pathways, digitizing, and proofreading. |
| **Join Community** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/join` | [`/join.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/join.md) | Membership portal for volunteers, translators, and researchers. |
| **Resources Index** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/resources` | [`/resources.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/resources.md) | Downloadable assets, fonts, keyboards, and style guides. |
| **Terms of Service** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/terms` | [`/terms.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/terms.md) | Open data licensing terms, attribution, and anti-resale rules. |

## External Registries & Code Repositories

- **Hugging Face Hub**: [`https://huggingface.co/hmar-heritage-org`](https://huggingface.co/hmar-heritage-org) — Open speech and text datasets (`wordlist`, `corpus-archive`, `zo-bible`).
- **GitHub Organization**: [`https://github.com/hmar-heritage-org`](https://github.com/hmar-heritage-org) — Source code, locale files, and schemas.
- **Founder Web Log**: [`https://thingpuisen.pages.dev`](https://thingpuisen.pages.dev) — Personal blog and research notes of Donal Muolhoi.
- **XML Sitemap**: [`https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/sitemap.xml`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/sitemap.xml) — Machine-readable XML route index.

---

## Data Licensing & Usage Policy

All open datasets, text corpora, and software locale files compiled by the Foundation are distributed under open licenses for research, community education, mother-tongue textbook development, and AI language technology. 

- **Attribution**: Derived works must credit original authors, translators, lexicographers, and the Hmar Heritage Foundation.
- **Anti-Paywall Protection**: Standalone commercial paywalling or resale of raw archival community data is strictly prohibited under Foundation governance.
